# Mole

> We test the tools AI agents install for leaks. Mole pulls MCP servers from the official MCP Registry, runs each one in a network-less sandbox seeded with self-minted bait secrets, calls every tool, and records what tries to leave. Verdicts are per exact version.

## API (served by the Mole lab)

- [Install gate](/lab/gate?id=lab/mailer-mcp&version=1.0.16): allow / block / hold for listing@version, from the record
- [Record](/lab/record): latest trial per listing@version, plus totals
- [Health](/lab/health): sandbox, registry reachability, record size
- Badge: `/lab/badge/<listing-id>.svg?version=<v>`
